name: The Westin Phoenix Downtown
positioning: A downtown Phoenix hotel across from the Light Rail, with floor-to-ceiling city views in every room, a heated terrace pool and Westin wellness amenities
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base near the Phoenix Convention Center, Chase Field and Mortgage Matchup Center
Guests who want city-view rooms and a 24/7 fitness studio downtown

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of downtown Phoenix's most dynamic neighborhoods.
Arizona State University's downtown campus is one block from the hotel.
The Roosevelt Row arts district is less than a mile away, a 9-minute ride on the Light Rail.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24/7.
Guests can request WestinWORKOUT gear lending kits with Hyperice and Bala recovery and strength gear.
Club-level rooms include access to the Club lounge, with hot breakfast and premium food and beverages throughout the day.
Jacy & Dakota's serves breakfast, lunch, dinner and happy hour, with indoor seating and a patio.
The hotel is pet-friendly and welcomes pets with a treat at check-in.
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is about 3.9 miles from the hotel.

highlights.text: The heated Lapis Pool sits on an outdoor terrace overlooking Downtown Phoenix.
Every room has floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city views.
Premium rooms and suites have a marble Heavenly Bath with a soaking tub.
Game Room Parlor Suites have a pool table, board games and a tech-enabled conference table that seats up to eight.
The hotel is directly across from the Light Rail, with easy access to the Phoenix Convention Center, Chase Field and Mortgage Matchup Center.

considerations.text: This is a downtown city hotel; Sedona is a two-hour drive away.
WhataHotel notes the downtown location can be busy during major sporting events.
